title: 2026 elections live updates as Trump rallies Florida voters, El-Sayed clashes with Stevens - CBS News
description: The November 2026 midterm elections are just four days away. Candidates in key races — and President Trump — are making their closing arguments to voters.

title: Carney says he can wait out Trump for trade deal - Politico
description: In an interview with POLITICO, the Canadian prime minister delivered a sharp brushback to Washington just days before the U.S. midterm elections.

title: Grand jury indicts ICE officer for striking Houston immigrant with vehicle - Houston Public Media
description: Representatives from ICE claimed Miguel Parra-Hernandez ran in front of the ICE agent's vehicle and that Harris County prosecutors do not have the jurisdiction to charge the agent. District Attorney Sean Teare said that claim was false.

title: Justice Department requests separating Alaska ballots that rank Dan J. Sullivan in Senate race - NBC News
description: The court filing, which cites the potential for “voter confusion,” did not spell out how segregating ballots would determine if a voter was confused.

title: 2026 NFL trade deadline: Potential landing spots for RB Jonathan Taylor, S Budda Baker and more - NFL.com
description: With the trade deadline set for 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Nov. 10, Bucky Brooks spotlights eight useful players who could be on the block, providing three practical team fits for each. Where might RB Jonathan Taylor, S Budda Baker and WR Brian Thomas Jr. end up?
